applies_to: All November1 hosted capability/model-service counter delta fields, including earlier shorthand actual_framework_stage_model_requests/capability_model_requests/root_model_counter_delta.
measurement: The actual model_access_lines parser retains successful HTTP200 GIN chat/generate access lines only. A delta proves that many successful requests, not the total attempted requests.
zero_delta: Zero successful HTTP200 requests alone does not establish zero attempted/failed/error requests. Total attempts remain UNKNOWN unless separate original evidence establishes them.
component_scope: Zero-model installed tool components invoke no agent generation by design; their no-model scope is distinct from the genuine capability model-service counters.
historical_originals: Original ZIPs, original reports and the preceding7run source-index are unchanged. This note clarifies measurement semantics without changing any PASS/FAIL outcome.
